description: Defines the AdvancedStructuredOutputParser class, which implements an INode interface to parse LLM outputs into structured data using Zod schemas, with JSON repair and auto-fix capabilities.

classes.name: AdvancedStructuredOutputParser
classes.description: A class that parses LLM output into structured data based on a Zod schema, with JSON repair and auto-fix features.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser with default labels, description, inputs, and schema.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the parser by parsing the provided Zod schema string, setting up JSON repair, and auto-fix options.
